facts.fact: PM MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) loans go to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises
facts.quote: for providing loans up to 10 lakh ( 20 lakh for those entrepreneurs who have availed and successfully repaid previous loans under the ‘Tarun’ category) to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.

facts.fact: Agri-allied income-generating activities (e.g. pisciculture, bee keeping, poultry) are also covered
facts.quote: Loans for agri-allied non-farm income generating activities, e.g. pisciculture. bee keeping, poultry farming, etc.

facts.fact: Kishor: above Rs 50,000 and up to Rs 5 lakh
facts.quote: Kishor किशोर Covering loans above 50,000/- and upto 5 lakh

facts.fact: Tarun: above Rs 5 lakh and up to Rs 10 lakh
facts.quote: Tarun तरुण Covering loans above 5 lakh and upto 10 lakh

facts.fact: Tarun Plus: above Rs 10 lakh and up to Rs 20 lakh
facts.quote: TarunPlus तरुणप्लस Covering loans above 10 lakh and upto 20 lakh

facts.fact: Tarun Plus is only for entrepreneurs who have availed and successfully repaid a previous Tarun loan
facts.quote: 10 lakh and upto `20 lakh under the Tarun Plus category (for those entrepreneurs who have availed and successfully repaid previous loans under the ‘Tarun’ category).

facts.fact: MUDRA loans up to Rs 20 lakh are collateral-free as per RBI norms
facts.quote: Hence, MUDRA loans, i.e., loans up to 20 lakh, have been made collateral free, as per the RBI norms in this regard.

facts.fact: Lenders are covered by the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU), managed by NCGTC
facts.quote: a Credit Guarantee Product is extended by creation of a Fund called Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units [CGFMU]. All eligible micro-loans sanctioned since April 08, 2015 are covered under the above guarantee. The Scheme is being managed by National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Ltd. [NCGTC]

facts.fact: Loans are given by Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs and NBFCs
facts.quote: These loans are given by Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs and NBFCs.

facts.fact: MUDRA itself does not lend directly to borrowers
facts.quote: MUDRA is a refinancing Institution. MUDRA does not lend directly to the micro entrepreneurs / individuals.

facts.fact: Apply at any of these lenders or online via udyamimitra.in
facts.quote: The borrower can approach any of the lending institutions mentioned above or can apply online through this portal www.udyamimitra.in

facts.fact: MUDRA has no agents or middlemen; keep away from people posing as MUDRA agents
facts.quote: Note:There are no agents or middleman engaged by MUDRA for availing of Mudra Loans. The borrowers are advised to keep away from persons posing as Agents/ facilitators of MUDRA/PMMY

facts.fact: The lender's norms and appraisal apply, so sanction is not automatic
facts.quote: The repayment terms will be governed by the cash flow of the enterprise and the eligibility of the borrower will be decided by the norms of lending institutions.

summary: mudra.org.in (updated 23 Oct 2026) confirms all four categories incl. Tarun Plus Rs 10-20 lakh for repaid Tarun borrowers, collateral-free up to Rs 20 lakh with CGFMU/NCGTC, lenders, no direct lending, no agents.
